column1: # Brumfiel, Eicholz & Shanks, GEOMETRY (Addison-Wesley, 1960) -- INDEX, verbatim transcription
# STAGE 1 of 2: page references below are the ORIGINAL book's page numbers, exactly
# as printed. A later mechanical pass must translate them to this edition's pagination.
# Format: level<TAB>term<TAB>pages
#   level 0 = main entry, level 1 = sub-entry indented under the preceding main entry
#   term    = entry text exactly as printed (original capitalisation, hyphens, commas,
#             and the book's own quirks, e.g. "Adams, John, C." and "Philosophy,")
#   pages   = page list exactly as printed; empty for heading-only entries
# SOURCE: sources/Geometry.pdf, rendered at 400 dpi with pdftoppm and read visually.
#   PDF 297 = book p. 283   (transcribed in full)
#   PDF 298 = book p. 284   (transcribed in full)
#   PDF 299 = book p. 285   (transcribed in full)
#   PDF 300 = book p. 286   (transcribed in full)
#   Offset book page N = PDF page N + 14 verified directly against the printed folios.
# INCOMPLETE -- BOOK p. 287 IS NOT IN THE SOURCE PDF.
#   The index does NOT end on book p. 286: it continues onto p. 287 (entries from
#   "Right angles" onward, i.e. roughly R-Z). sources/Geometry.pdf has only 300 pages,
#   so p. 287 was never photographed as its own frame. It appears only edge-on in the
#   curl at the right of PDF 300: the left column is legible but most of its page
#   numbers are sheared off by the curl, and the entire right column is absent.
#   The iPad scans do not help -- sources/scan-index/ covers no book page above 263.
#   Nothing from p. 287 is recorded below, to avoid guessed page numbers.
